# The trunk lane as A2 contract v2.1 modules in JAX + diffrax (plan step A2 + H3)

*Generated by `scripts/generators/build_jax_trunk_lane_module.py` in the separate `maillard-jax` env (jax 0.12.0.1, diffrax 0.7.2, float64, CPU); the engine's numbers from `jax_trunk_lane_module_reference.json` (core env, `build_jax_trunk_lane_reference.py`). Nothing shipped moves; the port is not imported by `src/kinetic_core`. Contract: [A2_MODULE_CONTRACT.md](../../docs/guides/A2_MODULE_CONTRACT.md) v2.1. The trunk module and the acrylamide lane: [jax_trunk_acrylamide_module.md](jax_trunk_acrylamide_module.md).*

## What was ported

- `src/kinetic_core_jax/trunk_lane.py`: the trunk lane's seven blocks as two modules composed after `trunk.build(lane="trunk")` -- `trunk_lane` (dicarbonyl 5, pyrazine 5, glycation 5, aqueous glyoxal 1, methionine 6, proline 4: 26 steps, 23 species) and `fed_3deoxy` (3 steps, owns DGAL, also part of the sulfur network). `compose_lane` gives `network.TRUNK_REACTIONS` in the engine's order: 42 species, 55 reactions, 109 coordinates.
- Every switch the lane reads, ported or refused (finding 5). The trunk module's own terms (a_w on `k_schiff`, the Amadori pH term, the 3-DG exit term), ported at rate level by the previous port, are now checked on trajectories.

Pots: the one panel bundle the engine routes to the trunk lane (Steinhagen 2021, glucose only, 18 min at 121 C, pH 4.36) at its point and both band corners (a_w scale, Amadori pH exponent, 3-DG exit exponent, the disputed and HPD sinks, all at one end); four synthetic isothermal pots, one per block the panel pot leaves idle (fed dicarbonyls + glycine; glucose + bound lysine; fed 3-DG; glucose + methionine + proline with B22 / B24 on and the exit term off); and a synthetic staircase profile (25 -> 160 -> 100 C, 2 K steps, pH 5.5, a_w 0.80, every block charged) at the shipped point and with the switches on. Named products: HMF, TDG, DDG, G, GO, MGO, DMHF, PZ, DMP, MPZ, CML, CEL, MTAL, MSH, DMDS, AP, ATHP, DGAL.

## Exact Jacobian (forward mode) vs central differences, at an interior point

Worst column error = max over observables of |difference| / max |reference| in that column, on the columns whose largest entry is at least 0.0001 of the Jacobian's largest ("rel"); the worst absolute difference over ALL columns, in dex per coordinate unit, beside it ("abs"). The engine moves every log10 k_ref, Ea and condition coordinate through its arguments (the exit exponent through the Config); the linear k_ref coordinates of the zero-k steps are checked against the port's own central differences only.
